options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Exclude alopecia, nausea and vomiting where the NCCP table explicitly does so; identify and grade the exact adverse event.

nausea_grade.label: Nausea grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No nausea.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Loss of appetite without alteration in eating habits.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Oral intake decreased without significant weight loss, dehydration or malnutrition.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Inadequate oral caloric or fluid intake; tube feeding, total parenteral nutrition or hospitalisation may be indicated.

nausea_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess appetite, oral intake, hydration, weight loss and need for enteral/parenteral support.

vomiting_grade.label: Vomiting grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No vomiting.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: One to two episodes separated by at least five minutes in 24 hours.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Three to five episodes separated by at least five minutes in 24 hours.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Six or more episodes in 24 hours, tube feeding/TPN or hospitalisation indicated.

vomiting_grade.assessment_guidance: Count episodes separated by at least five minutes and assess hydration, oral intake and need for hospital care.
